title: Lamarine
description: This mod adds a new ore that will spawn under the lands of oceans and rivers, so far you can make a pickaxe and a sword from it, which are much better than nezerite.
body:
Lamaryn — A New Mystical Ore for Minecraft

🔹 What the mod adds:
- Introduces the unique Lamaryn Ore, which generates in cave systems beneath oceans and rivers.
- The ore emits a faint glow, making it easier to spot in the dark.
- Mining it drops a shard, the core material for crafting.

🔹 Features and crafting:
- Combine Lamaryn shards with lapis lazuli and amethyst to forge a Lamaryn Ingot.
- Ingots can be used to craft:
- Lamaryn Sword — stronger than Netherite.
- Lamaryn Pickaxe — faster and more efficient than Netherite.

🔹 Why download this mod:
- Unlock a new tier of progression with weapons and tools beyond Netherite.
- Adds atmospheric glowing ore to underwater cave exploration.
- Balanced gameplay: obtaining Lamaryn requires combining multiple resources, making it rewarding yet challenging.
